text_block_list.text:
Special Week and the others throw 
themselves into rehearsing for the hero 
show at the Fan Appreciation Festival.

However, El Condor Pasa gives a cold 
shoulder, saying she won't participate as 
long as they are taking a different route.

However, it was all a lie just to surprise 
everyone! She made an unexpected guest 
appearance at practice, catching her 
fellow classmates totally off guard.

El Condor Pasa enjoying practicing for the 
hero show together with everyone.

Her quality as an "entertainer" who 
prioritized surprise and fun was a 
precious treasure that El Condor Pasa 
inherited from her father.
